example.title: Creased
lines: Every roof was once a page. Some still remember the words.
When the wind comes, the whole town rustles.
Do not get it wet.

world.title: Hyperspace
lines: The stars whisper secrets in our dreams.

world.title: Dreamscapes
lines: Dreams are the real thing, I can say with certainty.
In the forest, every branch whispers stories of old.
The moon dances, a true light in the quiet night.
next: I will show you my dreams in the morning.

world.title: Whispering Woods
lines: The whispers of the woods are deeper than the ocean.
A library that knows all secrets, but only to time.
Eternal silence where the air is crisp and clean.

world.title: Echoes
lines: The whispers of the river tell the tales of the night.
Silence holds the secrets of the moon.
Echoes fill the world with the weight of time.

world.title: Woven Halls
lines: The sun dances with the blades of grass.
Nature whispers to the buds of my heart.
From life's canvas, my wings have touched.
I see the world through your eyes.

world.title: The Sky's Edge
lines: The horizon is a whisper of the sky's edge.
The first light of the day breaks through the sky.
The world stretches out beyond the edge of the sky.

world.title: Cutting Edge
lines: Every morning the city wakes to a whispering breeze.
Even in the fog, the birds find their way.
Do you see the world through the leaves?

world.title: Greenhaven
lines: The sun peeks above the horizon and warms the land.
The birds sing their cheerful notes as they take flight.
The flowers bloom with colors that make me smile.
The beach is a perfect way to relax, the waves gently touching the sand.
The castle is a splendid structure, built with love and care from ancient times.
The fish are so vibrant, their scales sparkle like jewels.
The cat brings me joy with its playful antics.
Every day is a beautiful adventure in Greenhaven.

world.title: Cavern
lines: The shadows whisper tales of yore.
In the heart of darkness, light waits.
The stars are my guides in the unknown.

world.title: Mossy Wood
lines: The wind whispers in the branches.
The sunlight warms my skin.
Life is a sweet song we sing.
When the raindrops dance on the leaves, I smile.

world.title: Hollow
lines: The world begins with ice.
The sun wears a mask of morning.
Do not seek the peace. Seek the fight.

world.title: Hushed
lines: The first stars of the night fell silent.
They whispered in the cold air, the secrets of the earth.
In the heart of the frozen forest, a lone bird sang.

world.title: Endless Horizon
lines: The ocean stretches endlessly, a welcoming embrace.
Each wave carries the promise of new adventures.
A day in the sea is like a dream come true.
next: head to towards a nearby island

world.title: Whispering
lines: The shadow of the tree drifts.
The wind whispers through the branches.
A butterfly flutters by.
The sun appears on the horizon slowly.

world.title: Dreamscape
lines: The sun rises, casting a warm glow over the land.
Nature dances under the moon’s soft light.
Each day starts anew, in this dreamy world.

world.title: World Whispered
lines: The breeze whispered secrets to trees.
As the sun rose, a new day began.
Is this the way to the light?
